# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Titles:** Royal Gardner  <sub>[v3 c25 P43](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0043)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Roy  <sub>[v3 c25 P43](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0043)</sub>

## Appearance

Roy is adorably handsome with glorious dark eyes. He is known for his deep, black, velvety smile. He looks as though he ought to be very interesting, resembling his sister Dorothy if she had dreamy dark eyes.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c25 P48](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0048), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## Personality

Roy is considered clever, perfectly sweet, and possesses unfailing and deferential courtesy along with a pleading, delightful voice. He presents himself as a melancholy, inscrutable hero who woos with poetical compliments, exquisite letters, and flower gifts. However, he lacks a sense of humor and fails to get the point of funny stories, making him uninteresting to some despite his romantic charm.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c28 P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

## History

Roy Gardner attended Redmond College before being forced to give up his class two years prior to travel abroad with his sick mother. Upon his return, he resumed his studies at Redmond and actively courted Anne Shirley. He won over most residents at Patty's Place with his charm and courtesy, though he teased the Sarah-cat, who disliked him. During his courtship, he sent Anne orchids, violets, poetry, and regular letters, becoming widely expected by college social circles to propose to her. However, when he proposed, Anne rejected him, leaving him pale and looking foolish as he had felt very confident of her acceptance.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c28 P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022), [v3 c37 P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 c38 P19](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0019)_
